title: Deployment selector contract
description:
Create an apps/v1 Deployment named web with 3 replicas. Match app=web in selector and pod labels. Use container name web, image nginx:1.27-alpine, and containerPort 80.

STATIC LAB: YAML is parsed and listed fields are checked. Docker/HCL/shell are bounded authored text checks, not real tools. Passing is not a deployability or security guarantee.

starter.yaml:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: web

reference.yaml:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: web
spec:
  replicas: 3
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: web
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: web
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: web
          image: nginx:1.27-alpine
          ports:
            - containerPort: 80

hints: What must exist before the next operation can work?
Which field links this resource to the thing it controls?
What observation would prove readiness rather than just existence?
editorial: A Deployment selector must match its pod-template labels. Declaring containerPort documents a port; it does not itself expose the workload.
